title: Not Eligible | Denied Boarding | APPR
description:
Passenger was DENIED BOARDING on their flight. Denied boarding is handled under SEPARATE APPR provisions (Section 10-11 of APPR) with its own compensation schedule and process � it is NOT part of the flight disruption compensation flow. The FD chatbot is specifically for delay/cancellation disruptions, not denied boarding. Validates: (1) DDS detects the Denied Boarding event flag from Trip Tracer, (2) System correctly classifies denied boarding as outside the FD compensation scope, (3) Customer is redirected to the CORRECT process for denied boarding claims (Customer Relations, separate URL/phone), (4) The case is logged as "Not Eligible (Flight Disruption)" � not "Not Eligible" generically, since the customer MAY be eligible under the denied boarding process. This is a routing/scope test, not a true eligibility denial.

Prerequisites:
PNR: TC027 � single passenger (Adult). Journey: 1 leg, AC operated. Flight AC 330, YUL ? YYZ (domestic). Scheduled Departure: 10:00, Scheduled Arrival: 12:00. Flight operated normally � Actual Departure: 10:05, Actual Arrival: 12:02. Passenger was NOT on board. Denied Boarding Event: changeIdentifier = DENIED_BOARDING on MSL segment. Denial Type: Involuntary (INVOL). Denial Reason: DENIED_BOARDING_OVERSALES (Overbooking). Passenger had confirmed reservation (HK status), valid ticket, checked in on time, valid travel documentation. Boarding Status: NOT BOARDED (denied at gate). Post-Denial Outcome: Customer was NOT rebooked on an alternate flight. Travel Status: Did NOT travel on this journey. Compensation via FD chatbot: NOT applicable � Denied Boarding handled under separate APPR provisions (Sections 10�11), not the Flight Disruption compensation flow. Regime: APPR (domestic Canada). Timing: >72hrs elapsed since scheduled departure. Filing: Within 366-day limitation period.
